note: H100 run of configs/default.json: the teacher stays on the GPU and generation batches are larger. parallel_blocks: after stage 0 every block (G with all ten languages and six seeds, I, K, A, W, B, X) is queued at once; the gates are still computed and decide whether a result is a verdict or a record, but they no longer hold runs back. Learning settings, seeds, splits and gate thresholds are unchanged.
